story_overview: An injured Viktor is hunted through various locations, from dark tunnels to a concrete garage, by figures like Silas, Roman, and Leo. Watched from afar by a concerned Julian, the chase intensifies, leading to Viktor's dramatic fall from a building. He is briefly seen as a silhouette in a barred cell before being mysteriously pulled into darkness.

video_prompts:
Viktor: Man with a cut on his forehead and a bruise on his face, wearing a white blood-stained button-down shirt and dark pants.
Julian: Man wearing a white button-down shirt with contrasting black buttons.
the beige trench coat: Light beige, double-breasted man's trench coat with wide lapels, a matching fabric belt, and buttoned cuff straps.
Close-up at night of Julian wearing the beige trench coat. He speaks to Viktor with a concerned expression on his face against a dark, blurry background.
action_descriptions: Close-up at night of Julian wearing the beige trench coat. He speaks to Viktor with a concerned expression on his face against a dark, blurry background.

video_prompts:
The Quarry Tunnels: Underground complex consisting of spaces with rough-hewn, jagged, natural rock walls, ceilings, and uneven stone floors.
the caged industrial light: A circular, rust-stained metal industrial light fixture with a protective wire cage around a single bare bulb.

Close-up of Viktor, wearing the blood-stained shirt, in the rough-hewn passages of The Quarry Tunnels. He looks sharply over his shoulder, his face filled with alarm. The caged industrial light hangs from the rock ceiling above and behind him, casting long, dramatic shadows.

Roman: Bald man with a rugged face, wearing a simple white long-sleeved shirt.
the gray windbreaker: Light gray nylon windbreaker jacket with a full-length front zipper, elastic cuffs, and a simple high collar.
